    Changelog

    Source: NEWS.md

    canhrcolors 1.1.0

    R package

    • New colors: deep teal, tundra green, warm berry, warm ivory, charcoal and muted gold.
    • canhrcolors() takes several color names at once, ignores case and gives an error for unknown names.
    • scale_color_canhr() and scale_fill_canhr() warn when a plot needs more colors than the palette has.
    • New scale_colour_canhr() alias.

    Stata scheme

    • Deep teal, tundra green and warm berry are series colors 13 to 15.

    canhrcolors 1.0
